notes: A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. bmdb 1553 (library-ruling consistency pass), raylib, b1. EXPORT SURFACE: src/ is libraylib, installed by src/Makefile install. Every non-static function in these sources therefore has an open caller set (ADR-0011 742a1571, 6b28c8d7), and in-tree call sites prove nothing about a value arriving through its parameters. SELECTION: existing FP labels on non-static functions in exported sources whose recorded reason is caller-side (callers, call sites, contract, precondition, "always valid/never NULL"); tool-only files with their own main() excluded. METHOD: each row read at source by a reviewer; FP -> TP only where the verdict rested solely on callers for a parameter-derived value. Rows with a real in-function basis (a guard present in every build, a null-tolerant callee, a misfire, a value not from a parameter, a language guarantee) or where the keyword match was noise keep FP. assert/DEBUGASSERT/NEVER()/ALWAYS() are not guards (each compiles out or constant-folds in a compilable build). A fresh-context refuter re-checked a random sample of flips and stands. RESULT: 133 rows reviewed, 75 flip FP -> TP here, 58 keep FP. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
